responsibility: Declares the public query interface for the IPA static-variable reference pass. It exposes APIs to obtain the global read/write bitmap summaries for a function, finalize pass state, and map a variable decl to its ipa-reference bitmap UID. This header is a narrow client-facing interface to the analysis implemented in ipa-reference.cc.
same_name_distinction: Exposes just the client-facing query/finalization interface for the static-variable reference analysis implemented in ipa-reference.cc, rather than defining the generic ipa_ref data structures from ipa-ref.h.
